description: This file defines the RoleService class which manages roles, permissions, and role assignments within a system, including creating, updating, deleting roles, and assigning roles to members.

classes.name: RoleService
classes.description: A service class for managing roles, including creation, deletion, updating permissions, and role assignment to members.

methods.name: createRole
methods.description: Creates a new role after validating name uniqueness and permissions.

methods.name: getDefaultRoleId
methods.description: Returns the default role ID for a given MembershipRole.

methods.name: getMembershipRoleFromRoleId
methods.description: Retrieves the MembershipRole enum value corresponding to a role ID.

methods.name: assignRoleToMember
methods.description: Assigns a role to a member by updating the membership record.

methods.name: getRolePermissions
methods.description: Fetches permissions associated with a role.

methods.name: removeRoleFromMember
methods.description: Removes a role assignment from a member.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Retrieves a role by its ID.

methods.name: getTeamRoles
methods.description: Fetches all roles associated with a team.

methods.name: deleteRole
methods.description: Deletes a role if it is not a default/system role, reassigning users as needed.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates role permissions and attributes, disallowing updates to default roles.

methods.name: getUpdatePermissionChanges
methods.description: Calculates permission differences for role updates after validation.

methods.name: roleBelongsToTeam
methods.description: Checks if a role belongs to a specific team.
